results.text: Age-dependent pharmacokinetics of nifedipine in spontaneous hypertensive rats are associated with changes in gut microbiota and hepatic CYP3A1 expression. The reasons for the reduced efficacy of nifedipine in this population remain unclear. Daily Versus BID Nifedipine GITS in Severe Preeclampsia: Randomized Controlled Trial. Optimal dosing of nifedipine gastrointestinal therapeutic system (GITS) in pregnancies complicated by preeclampsia with severe features is unknown. We assessed whether nifedipine GITS 30 mg BID improved blood pressure control when compared with nifedipine GITS 60 mg daily.
